# parse lines: title on its own line; then bullet lines with director info
titles=[]
lines=[l.strip() for l in note['content'].splitlines() if l.strip()]
# First line is header '# Movie Recommendations'
# We'll iterate and detect pattern: title line not starting with '-' and not '#'
current_title=None
director=None
for l in lines:
    if l.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if l.startswith('-'):
        # remove leading '- '
        body=l.lstrip('-').strip()
        if body.startswith('director:'):
            director=body.replace('director:','',1).strip()
        continue
    # title line
    current_title=l
    director=None
    # after setting title, next bullet lines will set director
    # but we only add when we encounter director bullet after title; handle at end by waiting
    
# second pass with state machine
titles=[]
current_title=None
director=None
for l in lines:
    if l.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if l.startswith('-'):
        body=l.lstrip('-').strip()
        if body.startswith('director:'):
            director=body.replace('director:','',1).strip()
            if director=='David Fincher' or director.endswith(', and David Fincher'):
                titles.append(current_title)
        continue
    # title line
    current_title=l
    director=None

print('Fincher-directed titles:', titles)
